upright.general: The Star symbolizes hope, spiritual clarity, healing, and renewed faith in life. It appears after difficult experiences as a sign of recovery and optimism. The card encourages authenticity, inner peace, and trust in the future.
upright.in_love: Relationships become more open, sincere, and emotionally healing. Trust and mutual understanding grow stronger. Singles may experience hopeful new romantic opportunities based on honesty and emotional connection.
upright.in_situation: The situation improves gradually and brings positive opportunities. Inspiration, calm thinking, and faith in the process help achieve long-term success.
upright.meaning_for_today: Today brings hope, inspiration, and emotional healing. Trust in the future and allow optimism to guide your actions.
upright.card_advice: Believe in yourself and remain open to new possibilities. Stay calm, follow your inner light, and trust that difficult times are passing.

reversed.short: Doubt, discouragement, lost faith, emotional exhaustion.
reversed.general: Reversed The Star indicates disappointment, lack of motivation, or loss of hope. Emotional exhaustion and self-doubt block inspiration and healing. The card advises reconnecting with inner strength and optimism.
reversed.in_love: A relationship may suffer from emotional distance, insecurity, or disappointment. One or both partners struggle to trust the future of the connection.
reversed.in_situation: The situation feels uncertain due to pessimism or lack of confidence. Progress slows because fear and discouragement replace inspiration and faith.
reversed.meaning_for_today: Today feels a bit like looking up at a cloudy sky and convincing yourself the stars have vanished permanently. You are likely dealing with a heavy case of spiritual dehydration, cynicism, or creative burnout. It's easy to fall into the trap of self-pity or hopelessness right now, feeling like your luck has run out or that a tough situation will never turn around. You are essentially blocking your own healing by refusing to believe it's actually possible.
reversed.card_advice: Stop letting despair write your future narrative. The reversed Star isn't saying there is no hope; it’s saying you have cut yourself off from it. Treat yourself with radical tenderness right now—your emotional reservoir is bone dry. Drink some water, step back from the noise, and look at where you've let self-doubt kill your inspiration. The light hasn't actually gone out, you've just closed your eyes to it. Open them up and let the healing back in.
